title: Beekeeping
subtitle: 「養蜂／蜂群飼養與管理」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在專業語境中很自然的替代表達？
description: 「養蜂／蜂群飼養與管理」，有哪些真正接近、廣泛可用，或在專業語境中很自然的替代表達？

words.note: beekeeping 最直接、最正式的專業同義詞。
words.example: He studied apiculture before starting his own apiary.
words.exampleZh: 他在開設自己的蜂場前學習了養蜂。

exercises.original: The college offers a short course in beekeeping.
exercises.zh: 這所學院提供一門短期養蜂課程。
exercises.upgrade: The college offers a short course in apiculture.

options.explanation: 是 beekeeping 最正式、最專業的同義詞。
授粉是蜜蜂的重要功能，但不是養蜂本身。
昆蟲學範圍更廣，不等於養蜂。
是蜂場這個地方，不是活動。

exercises.original: Government support for beekeeping has increased in rural areas.
exercises.zh: 政府對農村地區養蜂業的支援有所增加。
exercises.upgrade: Government support for apiculture has increased in rural areas.

options.explanation: 政策／農業語境中非常自然。

exercises.original: Researchers are studying new methods of beekeeping.
exercises.zh: 研究人員正在研究新的養蜂方法。
exercises.upgrade: Researchers are studying new methods of apiculture.

options.explanation: 研究語境很適合專業術語。
種花可能幫助蜜蜂，但不是養蜂。
只是蜂箱維護的一小部分。

words.note: 最自然、最日常的改寫之一。
words.example: She started keeping bees in her garden five years ago.
words.exampleZh: 她五年前開始在花園養蜂。

exercises.original: She started beekeeping in her garden five years ago.
exercises.zh: 她五年前開始在花園養蜂。
exercises.upgrade: She started keeping bees in her garden five years ago.

options.explanation: 可能使用蜂蠟，但不是養蜂。

exercises.original: Beekeeping has become a popular hobby in the area.
exercises.zh: 養蜂已成為該區受歡迎的興趣。
exercises.upgrade: Keeping bees has become a popular hobby in the area.

options.explanation: 作為 hobby 的表達很自然。

exercises.original: He learned beekeeping from his grandfather.
exercises.zh: 他從祖父那裡學會養蜂。
exercises.upgrade: He learned about keeping bees from his grandfather.

words.note: 常見而自然，強調把蜜蜂作為需要照料和繁育的群體來飼養。
words.example: The family has been raising bees for generations.
words.exampleZh: 這個家庭世代都在養蜂。

exercises.original: The family has practised beekeeping for generations.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭世代都在養蜂。
exercises.upgrade: The family has been raising bees for generations.

options.explanation: 強調飼養和繁育，很自然。

exercises.original: Many small farms combine fruit growing with beekeeping.
exercises.zh: 很多小型農場把種植水果和養蜂結合起來。
exercises.upgrade: Many small farms combine fruit growing with raising bees.

exercises.original: He became interested in beekeeping as a teenager.
exercises.zh: 他青少年時開始對養蜂產生興趣。
exercises.upgrade: He became interested in raising bees as a teenager.

options.explanation: 很自然地表達飼養蜜蜂。

words.note: 較通俗、農業化的說法，強調把養蜂作為農業活動或生產活動。
words.example: Bee farming provides both honey and pollination services.
words.exampleZh: 養蜂既能提供蜂蜜，也能提供授粉服務。

exercises.original: Beekeeping is an important source of income for some rural families.
exercises.zh: 養蜂是部分農村家庭的重要收入來源。
exercises.upgrade: Bee farming is an important source of income for some rural families.

options.explanation: 強調養蜂作為農業／生產活動。

exercises.original: The cooperative provides equipment for beekeeping.
exercises.zh: 合作社為養蜂提供設備。
exercises.upgrade: The cooperative provides equipment for bee farming.

exercises.original: Training in beekeeping can help farmers diversify their income.
exercises.zh: 養蜂培訓可以幫助農民增加收入來源。
exercises.upgrade: Training in bee farming can help farmers diversify their income.

options.explanation: 把養蜂視作農業經營，很自然。

words.meaning: 蜜蜂飼養管理；養蜂管理
words.note: 較正式，強調飼養、照料、繁殖、健康與管理。
words.example: Good bee husbandry helps maintain strong, healthy colonies.
words.exampleZh: 良好的蜜蜂飼養管理有助維持強健健康的蜂群。

exercises.original: Good beekeeping requires careful attention to colony health.
exercises.zh: 良好的蜜蜂飼養管理需要細心留意蜂群健康。
exercises.upgrade: Good bee husbandry requires careful attention to colony health.

options.explanation: 強調飼養、照料與健康管理。

exercises.original: The manual explains basic beekeeping practices for healthy colonies.
exercises.zh: 手冊解釋維持健康蜂群的基本飼養管理方法。
exercises.upgrade: The manual explains basic bee husbandry practices for healthy colonies.

options.explanation: husbandry practices 是很自然的專業搭配。
只是維護蜂箱的一小部分。

exercises.original: Improved beekeeping can reduce colony losses.
exercises.zh: 改善蜜蜂飼養管理可以減少蜂群損失。
exercises.upgrade: Improved bee husbandry can reduce colony losses.

options.explanation: 強調良好管理可提升蜂群健康。
只是其中可能有幫助的一環。

words.note: 當 beekeeping 的重點是日常照料、蜂群健康、分蜂、蜂后、食物儲備等時，非常自然。
words.example: Managing bee colonies requires regular inspection and careful observation.
words.exampleZh: 管理蜂群需要定期檢查和細心觀察。

exercises.original: Beekeeping involves checking colony strength throughout the year.
exercises.zh: 養蜂包括全年檢查蜂群強弱狀況。
exercises.upgrade: Managing bee colonies involves checking colony strength throughout the year.

exercises.original: Successful beekeeping requires regular inspections.
exercises.zh: 成功的蜂群管理需要定期檢查。
exercises.upgrade: Successfully managing bee colonies requires regular inspections.

options.explanation: inspection 是 colony management 的核心工作。

exercises.original: Modern beekeeping often uses records to track colony development.
exercises.zh: 現代蜂群管理常使用紀錄追蹤蜂群發展。
exercises.upgrade: Modern management of bee colonies often uses records to track colony development.

options.explanation: 與追蹤 colony development 完全吻合。

words.note: 自然、較具生活感的說法，強調日常照料。
words.example: He spends much of the spring tending bees and checking hives.
words.exampleZh: 春季時，他花很多時間照料蜜蜂和檢查蜂箱。

exercises.original: He spends every weekend beekeeping at the family farm.
exercises.zh: 他每個週末都在家庭農場照料蜜蜂。
exercises.upgrade: He spends every weekend tending bees at the family farm.

options.explanation: 自然地表示日常照料蜜蜂。

exercises.original: Much of spring beekeeping involves checking food stores and brood.
exercises.zh: 春季很多養蜂工作都包括照料蜜蜂、檢查食物儲備和幼蟲。
exercises.upgrade: Much of spring work involves tending bees, checking food stores and brood.

exercises.original: She learned beekeeping by helping an experienced beekeeper.
exercises.zh: 她透過協助一名有經驗的養蜂人照料蜜蜂來學習養蜂。
exercises.upgrade: She learned by helping an experienced beekeeper with tending bees.

options.explanation: 可能用蜂蠟，但不是養蜂。

words.note: 當 beekeeping 的重點是檢查、清潔、修理和維護蜂箱時可作近義改寫。
words.example: Maintaining beehives is an important part of successful beekeeping.
words.exampleZh: 維護蜂箱是成功養蜂的重要一環。

exercises.original: Part of beekeeping involves inspecting and repairing hive boxes.
exercises.zh: 養蜂的一部分包括檢查和維修蜂箱。
exercises.upgrade: Part of beekeeping involves maintaining beehives.

options.explanation: 精確描述蜂箱維護這一部分工作。

exercises.original: Regular beekeeping includes cleaning old hive equipment.
exercises.zh: 日常養蜂包括清潔舊蜂箱設備。
exercises.upgrade: Regular work includes maintaining beehives and cleaning old hive equipment.

options.explanation: 清潔、檢查、維修蜂箱屬於維護工作。
蜂蜜由蜜蜂生產，不等於維護蜂箱。

exercises.original: Good beekeeping requires replacing damaged hive parts when necessary.
exercises.zh: 良好的養蜂管理需要在必要時更換損壞的蜂箱部件。
exercises.upgrade: Good beekeeping includes maintaining beehives and replacing damaged parts when necessary.

options.explanation: 更換損壞部件正是 hive maintenance。

words.note: 指管理一個或多個 apiaries、蜂箱、蜂群及其運作。
words.example: The course covers basic apiary management and colony health.
words.exampleZh: 這門課涵蓋基本蜂場管理和蜂群健康。

exercises.original: The training programme covers practical beekeeping and record keeping.
exercises.zh: 培訓課程涵蓋實際蜂場管理和紀錄工作。
exercises.upgrade: The training programme covers practical apiary management and record keeping.

options.explanation: 專業地強調蜂場整體運作。

exercises.original: Good beekeeping at a commercial scale requires careful planning.
exercises.zh: 商業規模的蜂場管理需要仔細規劃。
exercises.upgrade: Good apiary management at a commercial scale requires careful planning.

options.explanation: commercial scale 強烈支持管理整個蜂場。

exercises.original: The handbook introduces basic beekeeping for new farm operators.
exercises.zh: 手冊向新農場經營者介紹基本蜂場管理。
exercises.upgrade: The handbook introduces basic apiary management for new farm operators.

options.explanation: 對 farm operators 而言非常自然。

words.note: 專業養蜂語境中常用，表示管理蜜蜂群體的健康、生產力和繁殖狀況。
words.example: Good colony management can reduce the risk of disease.
words.exampleZh: 良好的蜂群管理可以降低疾病風險。

exercises.original: Good beekeeping can reduce the risk of disease in the hive.
exercises.zh: 良好的蜂群管理可以降低蜂群疾病風險。
exercises.upgrade: Good colony management can reduce the risk of disease.

options.explanation: 蜂群健康和疾病控制是 colony management 的核心。

exercises.original: Modern beekeeping includes monitoring queen health and brood patterns.
exercises.zh: 現代蜂群管理包括監察蜂王健康和育蟲情況。
exercises.upgrade: Modern colony management includes monitoring queen health and brood patterns.

options.explanation: queen health 和 brood patterns 都是專業蜂群管理範圍。

exercises.original: Effective beekeeping helps colonies survive difficult seasons.
exercises.zh: 有效的蜂群管理有助蜂群捱過艱難季節。
exercises.upgrade: Effective colony management helps colonies survive difficult seasons.

options.explanation: 重點是維持蜂群生存和健康。

falseSynonyms.zh: 蜂場不等於養蜂 apiary 是放置蜂箱、飼養蜂群的地方。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Beekeeping is the activity. An apiary is the place.

falseSynonyms.zh: 養蜂人不等於養蜂 beekeeper 是從事 beekeeping 的人。
蜂箱不等於養蜂 beehive 是蜜蜂居住、被管理的箱體／蜂巢結構。
蜂蜜生產不等於整個養蜂 Beekeeping 可以為了： 所以 honey production 只是其中一個目的。
falseSynonyms.point: - honey - beeswax - pollination - queen breeding - colony conservation

falseSynonyms.zh: 授粉不等於養蜂 蜜蜂可以幫助授粉，但 pollination 是生物過程／服務，不是飼養蜜蜂本身。
蜜蜂育種只是養蜂的一部分 bee breeding 特別指選育蜂王、品系或遺傳特徵。
形容詞不等於名詞 - apiculture = 名詞，養蜂 - apicultural = 形容詞，與養蜂有關的
詞義與詞性陷阱 - beekeeping = 養蜂活動 - beekeeper = 養蜂人 - beehive = 蜂箱／蜂巢 三者不能互換。
